description: This file implements a Next.js page component for displaying detailed information about a specific recipe, including server-side data fetching, metadata generation, and rendering of recipe details, images, and search functionality.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Pre-generates static params for all recipes by fetching all recipe IDs for static site generation.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Generates dynamic metadata for the recipe detail page based on the recipe ID.

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: Main server-side React component that renders the recipe detail page based on the provided route parameters.
